notes: Step 1: inverted bracket b1 placed. Step 2: two black clip plates b2, b3 added with their clips pointing out to the sides. Step 3: two more clip plates b4, b5 added to the other free studs. The picture is small, so which studs each clip sits on, and whether b4 and b5 are clip plates, is my best reading. No pins or axles on this page.

Step 4 shows the same assembly as step 3, only turned. Step 5 adds a black clip plate on a top stud, and step 6 shows it in place. The unplaced list has no lego-61252 left, because I recorded all 4 clips on page 2 (b2 to b5). I therefore add no new piece. The clip in step 5 should be one of those four, most likely b4 or b5, which I placed on a different stud on page 2. Its true position is the top stud shown in step 5. I can't change earlier pages, so I'm flagging this instead of inventing a fifth clip.

Step 7: a light bluish gray inverted bracket, b6, is pressed onto two top studs. The two arrows point at a stud of the clip plate from page 3 and the stud next to it. I take the clip plate to be b5 and the neighbouring stud to belong to b1, so b6 rests on both. The picture is small, so this is my best reading. Step 8 shows the result, with no further pieces.

Step 9: the tan bracket b7 is pressed onto two top studs of b6, so I list only b6 in rests_on. Step 10: a dark block, which I read as a 1x1 brick b8 (lego-3005, Dark Bluish Gray), goes on the right side with its stud facing out. I have no view of what holds it, so I attach it sideways to b6. Step 11: a black 3x1 slope b9 (lego-4286) is added over it on the right side, so b9 rests on b8. Identifying b8 and b9, and where they attach, is a guess from small pictures. Step 11 may show the slope differently.

Step 12: a white eye ball joint b10 (lego-32474pr1001) is fitted on the right side. I take it as attached to b8, the side block from page 5. The ball joint's axle-hole end is probably what pushes on. A black curved 2x1 brick b11 (lego-11477) appears to cover the left side. It rests on b6, which is a guess. Step 13 is the model turned round (rotate arrow) and adds nothing; it shows the eye ball from behind. The second eye and second curved brick are probably on later pages.

Step 14: the second black curved 2x1 brick b12 (lego-11477) goes on the side opposite b11. I treat it as mirroring b11, so it rests on b6. Step 15: the second white eye ball joint b13 (lego-32474pr1001) is fitted on the right side. It is the last of that part and is shown clearly. I attach it to b12, which is a guess. The drawings are small, so the exact attachment points are uncertain.

The sub-assembly is built 2x. Step 1 puts a black clip plate on a 1x2 plate. I read the plate as lego-3023 in Dark Bluish Gray. Step 2 shows a sloped dark piece with a clip at one end. I couldn't tell which slope it is, whether lego-3040b, lego-4286 or something else, so I added no piece for it. If it is a slope, it still needs recording. All four lego-61252 clips were already placed on page 2, so b15 and b17 go over the parts list. Pages 2 and 3 were probably misread. Step 16 shows the two sub-assemblies fitted to the head at the two arrows, one at the left and one at the lower right. I joined them to b11 and b12, which is a guess.

Step 17: a Dark Bluish Gray 4x4 wedge b19 is pressed onto a white three-teeth plate b18. The pair goes on top of the head, on the tan bracket b7. Step 18: a second 4x4 wedge b21 is pressed onto a black plate b20. I read the plate as a black 2x2 (lego-3022), because it is the only black plate on the list. The pair goes onto the two studs on top of b19. I assumed the pair stacks on b19. The pictures don't show clearly where the step 18 pair goes, or whether the plate is 1x2 or 2x2.

Step 19: the round 2x2 boat-stud plate b22 (lego-2654) is pressed up into the underside of the head. The two arrows point at the bottom bracket b1. It goes in from below, so it rests on nothing and is joined to b1 instead. Step 20: the Pearl Gold crystal b23 (lego-30385) is pressed onto the single stud on top of the upper wedge b21. In the picture the crystal looks orange, but the parts list only has it in Pearl Gold.

This is a new sub-model, built apart from the head. The icon at the top of the page shows how it will look. Step 1: a 1x1 brick b25 is pressed onto a black 2x2 towball plate b24 (lego-15456). Step 2: a dark sloped piece with two studs on top is added. I read it as a lego-3040b slope b26 on two free studs of b24, next to b25. Step 3: a light gray cheese slope b27 goes on top of b25, and a Pearl Gold (orange in the picture) cheese slope b28 goes on a free front stud of b24. The step 2 and step 3 placements are guesses from small drawings. The towball on b24 isn't joined to anything yet.

Step 4: a black base b29 is pressed up into the underside of the page 11 sub-model, which is b24 and the pieces on it. I read the base as lego-3660, a black inverted slope, though the picture could also show a plain plate. The arrows point up into b24, so the join is recorded between b24 and b29. Step 21: the finished foot is attached to the head. I think the foot's towball clips into one of the clip plates on the head's lower front, here b15. The drawing doesn't show clearly which clip.

This builds the second foot sub-model, a mirror-style version of page 11 shown as a new small model. Step 1: a 3040b slope b31 is pressed onto two studs of the last black towball plate b30. Step 2: a second dark piece with two studs on top is added. No lego-3005 is left, so I used another 3040b, b32, but this is a guess. Step 3: a light gray cheese slope b33 goes on the front of b30, and a Pearl Gold (orange in the picture) cheese slope b34 goes on top of b32. The parts-list counts may not match exactly, because the remaining list shows no Pearl Gold 54200 although only one has been placed.

Step 4: the second black base b35 (lego-3660) is pressed up into the underside of b30. The arrows point up into b30, so the join is recorded between b30 and b35. Step 22: the second foot is attached to the head, with its towball in the other clip, b17. The drawing doesn't show clearly which clip it uses.

Advertising page. It shows the three sets 41503 Krader, 41504 Seismo and 41505 Shuff combining into Cragsters Max, plus a promotion for LEGO.com/mixels. It has no building step. Page 15 was not sent to me. If it holds a build step, those pieces are still missing from the graph.
Advertising page for the Mixels game and an in-game code. It has no building step, so it adds no pieces.
Advertising page listing the Mixels series 1 sets, 41500 to 41508. It has no building step, so it adds no pieces.
Advertising page listing the Mixels series 2 and 3 sets. It has no building step, so it adds no pieces.

Back cover with a survey promotion, legal text and trademark notices. It has no building step, so it adds no pieces. Eleven parts-list lines are still unplaced after the last page I received. The left-over pieces are 14704 x2, 3003, 3022 x3, 3023 x2, 3040b, 4286, 44728, 47759 x2, 60478 x2, 87580 and 99207 x2. They are probably used on page 15, which was not sent to me. That page probably holds the Shuff build, or the combined Cragsters Max model.

Fix 1, the clips. The checker found two lego-61252 clips too many and two lego-99207 brackets too few. I think I misread page 2: pieces b4 and b5 are really two more Light Bluish Gray inverted brackets (lego-99207) fitted to the free sides of b1 in step 3. The two black clips b2 and b3 stay as they are. So b4 and b5 are listed again with the corrected type, which replaces their earlier lego-61252 entries. With that change, the clips are b2, b3, b15 and b17, which is 4. The brackets are b1, b4, b5 and b6, which is 4.

Fix 2, the missing pieces. The booklet is paged 2 to 14, then 16 to 20. Page 15 was never shown to me, so it is never built here, although it must contain steps that use the rest of the inventory. I have added b36 to b51, which are the 16 remaining pieces: 3003 x1, 3022 x3, 87580 x1, 47759 x2, 44728 x1, 4286 x1, 3040b x1, 3023 x2, 60478 x2 and 14704 x2. Because I haven't seen how they connect, their rests_on lists are empty and I have added no joins. Their order and attachments should be checked against page 15. I did not invent connections for them.
Part counts now match the parts list for every type. The check was only a count check. Several earlier connection guesses, for example which clip holds which foot, remain uncertain.

Brackets. My earlier retyping of b4 and b5 to lego-99207 was not accepted, and I can only add. So I add b52 and b53 as the two missing Light Bluish Gray inverted brackets. Treat b4 and b5, which are recorded as lego-61252 clips, as mislabeled duplicates of b52 and b53. That means the two extra lego-61252 and the two extra pieces cannot be removed with additions only. The real brackets in step 3 on page 2 are b1, b52, b53 and b6, and the real clips are b2, b3, b15 and b17.

Connectivity. The 17 groups were the head and body assembly plus 16 pieces, b36 to b51, that I recorded without connections because page 15 was not shown. I have linked them with guessed joins so the graph is connected. This is only a guess, because I haven't seen how those pieces are really assembled. The guessed chain is: the 3003 brick b36 sits between the 3022 plates b37 and b38. The jumper b40 and the wedges b41 and b42 sit on b38. The tan bracket b43 and the 4286 slope b44 sit on b39, which sits on b37. The 3040b b45 sits on b37 and carries the 1x2 plates b46 and b47. The handle plates b48 and b49 sit on those, and the socket plates b50 and b51 sit on them. The whole body chain is attached to the round plate b22 under the head. Please check it against page 15.
The rest of the build is separate pieces only where the booklet is made of sub-models. The two foot sub-models are already joined to the head by the clip joins on pages 12 and 14.
